# cloudflare_nel_setting (Resource)

Accepted Permissions

- `Zone Settings Read`
- `Zone Settings Write`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_nel_setting" "example_nel_setting" {
  zone_id = "023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353"
  value = {
    enabled = false
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `value` (Attributes) The NEL configuration value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--value))
- `zone_id` (String) Identifier of the zone.

### Read-Only

- `editable` (Boolean) Whether the setting is editable. This is false when the zone's plan does not include NEL or the NEL product feature is not enabled.
- `id` (String) Zone setting identifier.
Available values: "nel".
- `modified_on` (String) When the setting was last modified. A zero value (0001-01-01T00:00:00Z) indicates the setting has never been explicitly set and is using the default value.

<a id="nestedatt--value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `value`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Network Error Logging is enabled for the zone. When enabled, browsers report network errors to Cloudflare's NEL endpoint.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_nel_setting.example '<zone_id>'
```
